---
title: "wrapped fixture: a document-level fig-column page-inset in Typst"
filters:
  - wrapped
fig-column: [page-inset, margin]
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    fig-format: png
---

With `fig-column: [page-inset, margin]` in the document, Quarto reads the
first item, `page-inset`. Typst sets a code cell's
figure wider than the text, so a wrapped cell keeps its normal layout with a
warning. Typst keeps an image-form figure in the body, so it wraps.
